Updates are available today for the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
The cyclone that had been a concern for the Chennai–Puducherry coast has now faded. Despite the dissipation of the cyclone, heavy rainfall persists across South India. Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Kerala are currently experiencing significant precipitation, with forecasts indicating that these states will receive seven days of rain. Specifically for Chennai and Tamil Nadu, more showers are anticipated throughout this week. This ongoing wet weather suggests that while the immediate threat of a new cyclone forming and impacting the coast in November has passed, the region continues to grapple with substantial weather effects from existing conditions.
